messages.subject: Exclude variables from selectinput choice    [choises=names(dataset)]
parts:
Hello i use the code below and as a result i take a selectinput with all my Variable names(Year,Name,Team,Pts,Asts,.......).But i want to exclude Year,Name,Team from this.Any ideas?I know its wrong but i want something like this:

 choices = names(DatabaseEuroleague)-c("Year","Name","Team"))
      



shinyServer(
  function(input, output,session){
    
    output$userchoiceY <- renderUI({
      selectInput(inputId = "selecty", label="CATEGORY", selected = "Pts", choices = names(DatabaseEuroleague))
      
    })

Hi, more an R question, but this should work:

shinyServer(
  function(input, output,session){
    my_choices = names(DatabaseEuroleague)
    my_choices =  my_choises[ ! my_choises %in% c("Year","Name","Team")]
    output$userchoiceY <- renderUI({
      selectInput(inputId = "selecty", label="CATEGORY", selected = "Pts", choices = my_choices)
      
    })
